title: Canberra

pages.message: Though small particles typically remain in the atmosphere for only a few days, they can be transported far away from source regions by large scale weather systems.

note: Ours: the city's box filling with smog and clearing again once, picked by the app's rules (section 5); every hour of it.

sources.substitute: EIC 5151 links GEOS-CF v2, which starts on 2025-08-04; v1 holds every song.

units.<lat>_<lon>: µg/m³ (surface PM2.5 at 35 % relative humidity, hourly mean, the cell centred there)
